## Problem / Motivation
What user problem does this solve?

## Proposed Solution
Describe the expected behavior, UI/API impact, and how it preserves offline-first and unit-safety guarantees.

## Data / Localization Notes
- Does this add new UI text (requires both English and Simplified Chinese)?
- Does this add recipe or nutrition data (requires documented license/USDA source)?
